code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low arterial pH, low oxygen saturation, low pO₂), with mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and glucose are within normal limits. Findings suggest significant respiratory failure with possible underlying infection or inflammation; urgent clinical assessment is recommended.
